cohort: The study included 18 patients diagnosed with Acute Fatty Liver of Pregnancy (AFLP), resulting in 19 babies (one twin pregnancy), over a 5-year period at a tertiary Indonesian hospital.
finding: Acute fatty liver of pregnancy (AFLP) in Indonesian patients is characterized by common symptoms like jaundice and hypertension, high maternal (66.7%) and perinatal (57.9% IUFD) mortality rates, with the number of complications and hypertension significantly increasing the risk of maternal death.
birth_weight: Measured as a variable related to IUFD risk.
gest_age: Measured as a variable related to IUFD risk.
